Start date: 1386-10-13 (Gregorian calendar).  
47 weeks = 47 × 7 = 329 days.  
Add 1 more day → total 330 days.  

1386 is not a leap year (divisible by 4 but not by 400? 1386 mod 4 = 2, so not leap year).  
From 1386-10-13, add 330 days:  
Days left in 1386 after Oct 13:  
Oct: 31-13 = 18 days left.  
Nov: 30 days, Dec: 31 days → total 18+30+31 = 79 days in 1386 after Oct 13.  
330 − 79 = 251 days into 1387.  

1387 is not leap (1387 mod 4 = 3).  
Jan 31, Feb 28, Mar 31, Apr 30, May 31, Jun 30, Jul 31, Aug 31 → cumulative:  
Jan 31, Feb 59, Mar 90, Apr 120, May 151, Jun 181, Jul 212, Aug 243.  
251 − 243 = 8 days into September → 1387-09-08.  

FINAL_ANSWER: 1387-09-08
